## D — Accuracy and evidence notes: Parking, speed restrictions and initial pedestrian duties
Every knowledge statement for Parking, speed restrictions and initial pedestrian duties is tied to one physical page of the registered Delaware handbook snapshot. No outside legal explanation or inferred exception is added.
The continued prohibited-location list is reported as a list, not an exception-free absolute. Its prior-page introduction allows contrary posting, police directions and crash avoidance; downstream teaching must retain those conditions.
Speed table entries remain edition-specific, subject to the posted limit, emergency changes and reasonable speed for conditions. Historical pedestrian-fatality totals are omitted.
Open source limitation (verify DE-PARKING-CONTINUATION): The prohibited-location list continues across a page boundary. Its general posting, police-order and crash-avoidance exceptions must remain paired with the continued entries; do not flatten the list into unconditional prohibitions.
Open source limitation (verify DE-PARKING-SCHOOL): The school-zone speed footnote points to a statutory definition of when children are present without reproducing that definition. Do not infer hours, distance or presence criteria from this snapshot.
Open source limitation (verify DE-PARKING-VISUAL): Hill-parking and maneuver illustrations were not visually checked. Textual wheel-direction rules are supported, but image-dependent practice needs source-image validation.
Source quality: official issuer PDF. Extraction is text only; graphical content does not become a fact unless its supporting meaning is stated in the text. Unknown exam metadata and market evidence remain typed debt.
